import sys
input = sys.stdin.read().strip().split()
t = int(input[0])
i = 1
results = []
while i < len(input):
    x = int(input[i])
    y = int(input[i+1])
    if x == y:
        results.append("1 1")
    elif y % x == 0:
        b = y // x
        a = 1
        results.append(f"{a} {b}")
    else:
        results.append("0 0")
    i += 2
print("\n".join(results))
